name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+10

- For you: picks on Home and Movies & TV, Like/Love, Not interested
  - Home: For you row from your AniList list, scores and favourites (AniList recommendations + AI Picks), with a reason under each card
  - Movies & TV: For you row from your Stremio library and history plus Like/Love (TMDB recommendations)
  - Like/Love buttons on Movies & TV titles; sent to Simkl as 8/10 ratings when Sync to Simkl is on
  - Long-press a pick: Not interested hides it and shows fewer like it
  - Unit tests for the ranking, seeds and TMDB parsing
- Retire the legacy Feather link; source URLs as plain text in the README
